Field data processing

# Libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read_csv("E:/PPW_field_data.csv")
```

# Post-Tubbs investigations
```{r}

# status by plot
fates18 <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(fate4.18),
            DBH_cm.18 > 10) |>
    count(Plot, Species, fate4.18, name = "n")
view(fates18)

# status by species
fates_spp <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(fate4.18),
            DBH_cm.18 > 10) |>
    count(Species, fate4.18, name = "n")
view(fates_spp)
```

# BA
```{r}
ba <- data |>
    select(Plot, Species, Num, Live.17, fate4.18, DBH_cm.17, DBH_cm.18, DBH_cm.19) |>
    filter(!is.na(DBH_cm.17)) |>
    mutate(ba_m2_17 = ((pi * (DBH_cm.17)^2) / 40000)) |>
    group_by(Plot) |>
    summarize(ba_m2_17 = sum(ba_m2_17))
view(ba)

# using BFA
library(BerkeleyForestsAnalytics)

ba <- data |>
    select(Plot, Species, fate4.18, DBH_cm.18) |>
    rename(plot = Plot, species = Species, status = fate4.18, dbh = DBH_cm.18) |>
    mutate(site = "PPW", exp_factor = 50, status = case_when(
    status %in% c("LN", "LR") ~ 1,
    status %in% c("DN", "DR") ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
    filter(dbh > 10, species != "ARCMAN")

ba$status <- as.character(ba$status)
ba

comp <- ForestComp(data = ba)
comp
write_csv(comp, "E:/PPW_ba_dom.csv")

```

# DBH comparison
```{r}
data |>
    filter(!is.na(DBH_cm.18), !is.na(DBH_cm.19)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = DBH_cm.18, y = DBH_cm.19)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "steelblue") +
    labs(
        x = "DBH cm 2018",
        y = "DBH cm 2019",
        title = "DBH comparison between 2018 and 2019"
    )
```
